title: Steady-state merge
summary: Implement baseline-based, existence-first convergence against the live Athenaeum endpoint.
produces: Baseline diff and existence-first merge engine
Transactional inbound apply with privacy filtering
Coalesced replacement-required event for a missing previously used collection

conditions: Three or more devices converge under interleaved changes.
Equal-timestamp ties and malformed records are reported without corrupting the baseline.
Classification filtering and I1/I2 hold on inbound apply.
A previously used missing collection stops the pass, preserves local state and baseline, emits one decision event, and performs no POST.
The automatic-recreation mutation makes the guard test fail.
completion.summary: Steady-state merge, transactional inbound apply, and isolated single-flight publication are implemented and guarded.
evidence: packages/compendium_core/test/sync/sync_merge_test.dart covers three-device manifest and baseline convergence across interleaved passes, all four both-present baseline rows, the total baseline table, and independent existence/body maxima.

packages/compendium_core/test/sync/sync_merge_test.dart reports equal-time ties, while app/test/sync/sync_coordinator_test.dart verifies tie, malformed, and unresolved peer records do not advance rejected addresses in the baseline.

packages/compendium_core/test/sync/sync_apply_test.dart covers classification filtering, receive-only credentials, read-modify-write privacy, and transaction rollback; tools/ci/test_check_sync_invariants.py covers I1/I2.

app/test/sync/sync_coordinator_test.dart covers previously-used missing-store stop, preserved state, one coalesced event, zero pre-confirmation POSTs, idempotent confirmation, and configured pause on decline.
The replacement test was run against the automatic-createStore mutation and turned red before the final implementation was restored and the full preflight passed.

packages/compendium_core/test/storage/sync_storage_test.dart covers forward and cyclic live references, rejects tombstoned inbound parents, rejects links or slots targeting locally tombstoned dances, isolates dependent-ID collisions to their conflicting inbound owners, preserves per-record state when an inbound tombstone invalidates a join, and preserves a parent when a stored custom-field definition is corrupt; the reference, dependent-ID isolation, and partial-apply mutations were run red before restoration.

packages/compendium_core/test/storage/sync_storage_test.dart covers dependent-parent pruning after an inbound parent write fails; in `cd packages/compendium_core && fvm dart test test/storage/sync_storage_test.dart --plain-name 'skips dependent parents when an inbound parent write fails'`, restoring the prior single parent-write loop made the guard red with a foreign-key constraint failure while inserting the dependent program slot, before restoring the grouped validation and rerunning it green.

packages/compendium_core/test/storage/sync_storage_test.dart covers the same-kind D->dance->dance cascade; restoring the fixed-point group validation to one pass made `cd packages/compendium_core && fvm dart test test/storage/sync_storage_test.dart --plain-name 'prunes same-kind dependents after an inbound parent write fails'` red with a foreign-key constraint failure while inserting `dependent-link`, before restoring the fixed-point implementation and rerunning it green.

packages/compendium_core/test/storage/sync_storage_test.dart rejects inbound non-shareable custom-field definitions and dance values for existing local and same-batch definitions before parent writes; in `cd packages/compendium_core && fvm dart test test/storage/sync_storage_test.dart --plain-name 'rejects non-shareable custom-field definitions and inbound values'`, replacing the storage classification result with `null` made the test red with an expected empty applied list but three applied addresses, before restoring the implementation and rerunning it green.
app/test/sync/sync_coordinator_test.dart proves a configured device with no local baseline epoch stops at the fresh-attach boundary without manifest, blob, POST, or publication work.

app/test/sync/sync_coordinator_test.dart proves a newer local wire hash is not overwritten by an inbound winner, reports concurrentLocalChange, and publishes a fresh post-apply snapshot; in `cd app && fvm flutter test test/sync/sync_coordinator_test.dart --plain-name 'skips a remote winner when its local address changed mid-pass'`, setting expectedWireHashes to const {} made the test red with Bad state: No element before restoration.

app/test/sync/sync_coordinator_test.dart proves missing-blob negotiation runs only for hashes in the final manifest after merge, and keeps the protocol-limit batching at 10,000 hashes; in `cd app && fvm flutter test test/sync/sync_coordinator_test.dart --plain-name 'uploads only blobs retained by the final manifest'`, restoring the pre-merge upload made the test red with expected completed but actual failed before restoration.

app/test/sync/sync_isolate_test.dart requires an interrupted apply to remain entirely pre-apply rather than accepting a non-transactional all-after state; in `cd app && fvm flutter test test/sync/sync_isolate_test.dart --plain-name 'terminating during apply leaves an atomic database state'`, replacing the real transaction with direct action made the test red because the persisted values were not the required wholly pre-apply state before restoration.

app/lib/main.dart routes shutdown and database replacement through awaited coordinator disposal, and settings_keys.dart documents the persisted salted, slow identity-verifier set rather than a single last identity.

The tombstone classification guard was mutation-proven red and restored: restricting the definition check to live records made `rejects tombstoned non-shareable custom-field definitions and values` apply the inbound private definition; bypassing classification for tombstoned dances made the same guard apply the local tombstoned dance. Restoring from `0f1c8e534` made both runs green.

On `5a2b435af`, restoring the prior raw SHA-256 marker implementation made `cd packages/compendium_core && fvm dart test test/storage/sync_storage_test.dart --plain-name 'stores salted slow verifiers and migrates legacy fast markers'` fail because the no-ID snapshot retained the raw hash (`Expected: []`, `Actual: ['fa79dd1ee8fe25d601870c1b05bb634a8086134bfbe57f870549e2ddaca444e2']`) at `sync_storage_test.dart:106`; restoring `5a2b435af` made the guard green.
The final implementation head `dd17cf5ce` was validated with `python3 tools/preflight.py`, which completed with 30 steps passed and 0 skipped.
